name: parakeet-cpp
description: Parakeet (NVIDIA FastConformer ASR + Sortformer diarization) inference in pure C++/ggml. Ships CTC, TDT, EOU and Sortformer engines under one Engine umbrella plus the cross-engine StreamEvent API, with an optional Apple Core ML encoder sidecar; sourced from tetherto/qvac-ext-lib-whisper.cpp engines/parakeet. This republish advances the pin to master 5e57a692, the single source archive shared with whisper-cpp, tts-cpp and audiogen-cpp, and raises the ggml-speech floor to 2026-08-07 for the Vulkan matmul src0 binding fix and the OpenCL im2col rewrite; engines/parakeet itself is unchanged. Consumers use find_package(qvac-parakeet CONFIG) + qvac::parakeet: the installable artifacts live under the qvac-parakeet name so this port is co-installable with whisper-cpp.

coreml.description: Enable the Apple Core ML (Neural Engine) encoder sidecar (Apple-only; presence-driven at runtime).
